description: The Create Patient dialog with Patient Type = Walk-in is 1099px tall, with overflow-y: visible and no max-height. At 1280x800 the dialog spans y=-149 to 949, the title is clipped above the viewport, and the Create button (bottom at y=924) cannot be reached. Mouse-wheel scrolling does nothing (dialog scrollTop stays 0) and Playwright cannot scroll it into view. At 1280x900 the button is still off-screen (974). Walk-in registration is impossible on common laptop screens without browser zoom.
expected: The dialog is capped at the viewport height and scrolls internally, with the footer buttons always visible.
actual: Create is unreachable at any viewport shorter than about 1100px.
suggested_fix: Add className='max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' to the Patient DialogContent, with a sticky footer for Cancel/Create.

description: PHARMACIST has no Patients link, yet typing /dashboard/patients loads the full page. Search, Edit (pre-filled dialog), Archive (+Undo) and Export CSV all work; the export contains 13 patients with phones. NURSE and MANAGER can archive too. Nothing marks Archive, Link Portal or Export as admin-level. Mapped defect 11, confirmed.
expected: A role guard on the patient routes and endpoints; destructive and export actions limited to the appropriate roles.
actual: Full read, write and export for every tested role.
suggested_fix: Add @Roles on PatientsController (list/read for clinical and front-desk roles; archive/export for OWNER/ADMIN); add a frontend route guard.

description: A MANAGER walk-in creates the patient, then 7 calls to GET /appointments/available-slots each return 403 and are swallowed. The UI shows a red toast 'No slots available — No available consultation slots found in the next 7 days for the selected doctor.' No appointment is booked. Mapped defect 17, confirmed.
expected: 'You don't have permission to book appointments', or the Walk-in option hidden for MANAGER.
suggested_fix: In the walk-in loop, stop on 401/403 and surface the error; only treat an empty slots array as 'no slots'.

description: For NURSE, the walk-in 'Room (optional for OPD)' dropdown is empty because GET /appointments/rooms returns 403. No message appears, and the appointment is booked with roomId NULL (DB-verified: 2026-11-08 09:00–09:30, no room).
expected: Rooms listed, or a note that the room will be assigned by reception.
actual: An empty select with no explanation.
suggested_fix: Allow NURSE on GET /appointments/rooms, or hide the Room field when it is forbidden.

description: The Export CSV 'Consultation Type' column is blank for patients created as Offline. Patients-topic defect 4, confirmed in the exported file.
suggested_fix: Include consultationType in the row mapping.

criterion: Text fit / edge alignment / primary action placement
description: The Patients search input is squeezed to 158px in the filter row: the placeholder is cut ('Search by nar') and the hint text wraps beneath, while the four selects get 128–192px each. The primary 'New Patient' button floats mid-header (x 730–878), separated from Clear Filters / Export CSV (x 976–1256) and not aligned to either edge.
expected: Search gets flex-1 as the primary filter; New Patient aligned with the other header actions.
actual: Cramped search; a floating primary button.
suggested_fix: Give the search wrapper flex-1 min-w-[240px]; group New Patient with the right-hand actions.
